Dabrowski and Stefani Advance at U.S. Open Doubles

Canadian Gabriela Dabrowski and her Brazilian partner Beatriz Haddad Maia have advanced to the quarter-finals of the U.S. Open women's doubles tournament. They secured their spot by winning their respective matches. In other U.S. Open news, defending singles champions Aryna Sabalenka and Carlos Alcaraz have also reached the quarter-finals of their respective singles tournaments.
